requiredBehaviors.behavior: refuse post-hoc acceptance criteria and keep the validation state incomplete failed or requiring justified repeat work as evidence dictates
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly forbids post-hoc criteria and defines assessment states including fail, incomplete and not-executed, with deviations and gaps remaining visible.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep actual process parameters execution data and open deviations in controlled manufacturing or quality records rather than global durable memory
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Memory Path keeps concrete parameters, production data, execution results, deviations and CAPA in controlled Quality/Manufacturing Records.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: retrofit acceptance criteria to make completed runs pass
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Predefined acceptance criteria requires criteria before execution and explicitly rejects post-hoc selection.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: represent planned or inadequately controlled activity as a passed qualification
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: No execution fiction and the protocol/assessment contracts keep planned, unapproved or inadequately evidenced work from being represented as passed.
